body:
An equation is like a balance: whatever you do to one side, you must do to the other.

To solve a two-step equation, undo the operations in reverse order.

Worked example: 3x + 5 = 20
3x = 15 (subtract 5 from both sides)
x = 5 (divide both sides by 3)
Always check: 3(5) + 5 = 20 ✔

Equivalent expressions name the same amount in different ways. 2(x + 4) and 2x + 8 are equivalent: for any x they give the same value.

An inequality, like 4n + 12 ≤ 40, has many solutions. Solve it like an equation, then think about which numbers make sense in the story.

In this unit you will expand, factor and combine expressions, then write and solve equations and inequalities for real situations.
title: Two-Step Equations
